provenance.note: ot_full and independent_noise use the first 16 candidates before any data-dependent assignment; current and residual share the full prepared batch. Validation loss uses common independent Gaussian for all methods.

analysis_revision.timing: Before the first complete 2000-step evaluation; training source unchanged

dataset.sampling: uniform source with replacement; one scale per logical batch; indexed by optimizer step/item

noise_assignment.limitations: Fixed real batch and repeated seeds; marginal equality of the 16-candidate set does not imply independence conditional on images or masks. Residual uses the same preparation as current.

limitations: One training seed. Bootstrap intervals are conditional on the fitted models and resample development source images or synthetic shapes. Timing includes concurrent preflight work and excludes unrecorded initialization, evaluation and saving intervals; it is not an isolated hardware benchmark.
